messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D trench-defense game for phone and tablet based on the user’s concept: aim a machine gun and traverse the trench to shoot incoming soldiers.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls and responsive layout.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using Three.js from a CDN, with procedural low-poly battlefield/enemies and original UI.
- Added desktop keyboard/mouse controls and mobile touch controls; assumed the game should have endless waves, ammunition, reloads, score, and a breach/lives system.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` implementing the game and controls.
- Ran the game via `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser confirmed the title screen and active gameplay render.
- Fixed camera parenting, adjusted firing-lip height, and suppressed the missing favicon request.
- Captured and inspected screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/title.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/play2.jpg`.

### Active
- No active changes; gameplay implementation is in place.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally test touch controls and gameplay interactions, then report the implementation and assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, title/game-over overlays, controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive game HUD, title screen, and mobile touch layout.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, enemies, weapons, wave logic, scoring, input, and audio.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165.0/build/three.module.js`; browser testing showed no game runtime errors, only expected software-renderer performance warnings.

Implemented **OVER THE TOP — Trench Defense**, a playable 3D trench-defense game.

- Use **A/D** to traverse, **Space** to fire, **R** to reload, and **right-click** to aim.
- Touch controls are included for phones and tablets.
- Includes endless waves, ammo and reloads, scoring, sound toggle, and a breach/lives system.
- The game uses Three.js from a CDN.

Run it locally with `python3 -m http.server 3002`, then open `http://localhost:3002`. `game.js` passes `node --check`. Screenshots were saved to `/tmp/opencode/title.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/play2.jpg`.
